trace.cypher: MATCH (t:Team)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (t)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City), (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t) WHERE ((CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) > 1989 AND o.name <> 'Gabe Plotkin and Rick Schnall') OR (o.name = 'Atlanta Spirit LLC' AND CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) = 1967)) RETURN DISTINCT c.city_name AS col1, t.founded_year AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
